Chapter 97 Kungfu (For Subscription)

The cultivation of this Tianyi Emperor Kungfu is divided into several stages, and each stage has different mysteries, but none of them is extremely powerful, and even more overbearing.

The first stage:

The rules of envoy heaven and earth can use the laws of the operation of heaven and earth to entrust the power between heaven and earth. This stage is not much different from other ordinary practitioners, and they all attack according to the rules of heaven and earth.

But Zhong Yu uses luck points to cultivate, and the power he cultivates is the purest and purest. You must know that the way of heaven and humanity grows and grows only with luck points, and Zhong Yu can enjoy the same treatment as the way of heaven and humanity at the beginning. When practicing, he is born more than one level higher than other ordinary practitioners.

Moreover, when the power cultivated by oneself is used to attack and other effects, it is born with a supreme aura like the way of heaven. With the majesty of this aura, it can suppress other forces below the way of heaven. The growth rate of the weapon is average, and it is several times stronger than others in his life!

However, in the reincarnation of heaven, there are debts and repayments! This sentence is not only applicable in the way of heaven, even in other places, it is also a famous principle from ancient times.

Since Zhong Yu's practice is so heaven-defying, the price he pays will be even greater. It will take a year just to achieve a preliminary cultivation and have a certain power. During this period, the daily practice consumes The Luck value of a person must be above 100.

And if you want to make a small success, it will take three years, and you will consume more than a thousand luck points every day. It takes nine years to achieve great success, and 10,000 luck points are consumed every day!

As far as this first stage of cultivation is concerned, Zhong Yu roughly estimates that he needs more than 40 million luck points. This number makes him feel desperate. If others don’t say it, they will say that he spent five years on destroying it. In the world of the Three Kingdoms, which was plundered in the same way, the luck points obtained are only a mere two million!

It is one-twentieth of this number. If Zhong Yu really went to fight those small worlds and destroy the past one by one, he would have to destroy twenty of them to barely complete the cultivation, not to mention how much time it took!

Zhong Yu has already asked the system before, if he has not thoroughly cultivated to the point of becoming a god and established a heaven, then his lifespan will definitely not exceed 100 years!

And to destroy these small worlds, wouldn't that mean that most of his life would be spent in them? Then should he live forever and rule the heavens and worlds!

Of course, it is impossible for a small world to have so many luck points for me, but I can capture those big worlds, just like the current main world, expand my territory as much as possible, and plunder more people, then Obtaining luck points by yourself is definitely not comparable to what those small worlds provide!

If nothing else, just talk about now! In this battle in the Lost Land of Edel Alliance, he had more than 30,000 barbarians who died because of him, and he gained 1500 points of luck from it, which is almost what he got from destroying the entire Three Kingdoms world One-thousandth of it!

Not to mention that these populations are only 1/10 of the Eder Tribal Alliance. If the population of the entire alliance is killed by himself, it will be 1% of the Three Kingdoms World. The three forces in the entire plain have a population of one million. If they are all destroyed, he will have 400,000 luck points!

And these are just ordinary savages on the plain. If you count those extraordinary powers such as fighting spirit, then they have more luck points, not to mention those who are sacrificed like The gods in the state of gods.

It is estimated that if he really kills the whole plain once, the luck obtained will definitely be calculated at 5 million or more. Killing a demigod with divinity will provide him with 500,000 luck points and ignite the magic fire After that, depending on the strength of that demigod, he can provide himself with more than 1 million luck points.

As for the true god with the godhead, he can provide himself with at least 5 million luck, but in the whole plain, only the Ruien Kingdom enshrines a true god, and the other two major forces are just demigods who have just ignited the divine fire.

In addition, the large and small tribes enshrine hundreds of demigods and below, the ancestor spirits with the characteristics of gods, according to the strength of the strength, can also provide themselves with tens of hundreds, thousands of tens of thousands of gods. luck.

There is no need to think about the true god who has the godhead here. After becoming a true god, he can establish his own kingdom of God, transcend this world, and become a demiplane state attached to the main world.

The real body of the gods is hidden in the kingdom of God. Do you want to cross the barrier of the main plane and go outside the plane to find the kingdom of the gods? How difficult is it? With your own strength, you don't even have to think about it! Maybe after I become a god and establish a heavenly court, I can try to see if I can do it?

But if other demigods, or the ancestor spirits under the demigod, can provide themselves with the help they can provide with their own strength and system, they can give it a try. If they can succeed, then it will be worth 5 million luck points. !

With these 5 million luck points, how much help can it provide for your cultivation and the development of your power, at least if you have reached a small success in the first stage of cultivation, you don't have to worry about lack of luck!

Of course, it is not that there is no better shortcut to practice faster. Tianyi Emperor Kung Fu, as the name suggests, is a kung fu practiced by an emperor!

Since an emperor cultivates, there is a saying that the country is the state, and the state is the state. The emperor and his country are inseparable, and the two have long been closely united, so an emperor can practice with the help of his country.

The speed of cultivation mentioned just now is just the cultivation level of one person in that place without any help. If we use the power of the whole country, the whole country can practice together.

Then although the luck point cannot be reduced, the time of practice can be accelerated, so that the truth can achieve the task of becoming a god and establishing the heaven in time before its life span dissipates!

This is similar to humanity, allowing all the creatures under his command to unknowingly refine Qi luck together, thus greatly speeding up the speed of his own refining.

And Zhong Yu just changed a method, letting all the ruling creatures under the rule of Yuguo to help him cultivate, and it was with their help that he completed it in a short period of time. Most of the cultivation of Xiaocheng in the first stage.

But the consumption of luck points is also extremely terrifying. The 300,000 luck points that were originally left have consumed 200,000 at this moment, and he dare not move the remaining 100,000. This is what he uses to save his life at critical moments of!

Without these 100,000 luck points, which are used to request some support from the system, then if I really cornered the demigod in this alliance and he took action against me regardless of his status, then who should I ask for help? Who will save myself?

It's not my habit to let fate be my own, and I have to be fully prepared to keep my life the first priority, that's what my character will do!
